tradeInCreditRangeEn: $35–$695 in credit toward your next iPhone
tradeInCreditRangeZh: 折抵下一部 iPhone 可获 $35–$695 积分

carrierDeals.headlineEn: Up to $830 — no trade-in required to qualify
carrierDeals.headlineZh: 最高 $830，无需以旧换新即可符合资格

carrierDeals.headlineEn: Up to $830 for eligible trade-in in any condition
carrierDeals.headlineZh: 符合条件以旧换新任意成色最高 $830

tradeInSteps.titleEn: See what your smartphone is worth
tradeInSteps.bodyEn: Answer a few questions to get your estimated trade-in value.
tradeInSteps.bodyZh: 回答几个问题即可获得预估折抵金额。

tradeInSteps.bodyEn: Trade-in credit applies to any payment option — instant with Apple financing, after inspection with Buy, or as carrier bill credits.
tradeInSteps.bodyZh: 折抵可用于任意付款方式——Apple 分期可即时抵扣；直接购买则在收到并验机后入账；运营商分期则为账单抵扣或即时积分。

tradeInSteps.bodyEn: Keep your old device until the new one arrives; Apple sends a trade-in kit with backup and shipping instructions.
tradeInSteps.bodyZh: 在新机送达前保留旧机；Apple 寄出以旧换新套件并邮件说明备份与寄回步骤。

tradeInSteps.bodyEn: After inspection, if condition matches your estimate the trade-in completes; otherwise Apple emails next steps.
tradeInSteps.bodyZh: 验机后若状况与估价一致则完成折抵；否则 Apple 邮件告知后续步骤。
